  // using both the symmetric event plane method (colored circles) and 
  // the mixed harmonic method (open black circles)
  // for 19.6 (15-25% cent.), 62.4 (6-40% cent.), 130 (6-40%),
  // and 200 GeV (6-40%) AuAu collisions
  // 1 sigma statistical error bars errors are shown
  // Josh Hamblen
